channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Robert Horry | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Robert Horry from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Robert Horry, Goga Bitadze
item.description:
Draymond Green on the Luka vs Goga beef:

“Goga Bitadze said he would fu*k his whole family up. At some point I can’t stand for that, I got to stand up for myself. Robert Horry goes on the show and brings me up in the conversation. Maybe I think he wanted some attention. So, everybody let’s get give him the attention he deserves. But I don’t know what I had to do with this.”

Draymond Green on Robert Horry, Goga Bitadze, Mar 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Del Harris on Byron Scott, Jerome Kersey, Robert Horry
item.description:
Harris told The County Sun during shootaround.

“If it doesn’t work out, we’ll put Jerome Kersey in there. At this point, Jerome will be a backup, and we have to get him settled into that. And Byron Scott is a backup. Kobe knows when Robert’s back, he’ll go back (to coming off the bench).”

Del Harris on Byron Scott, Jerome Kersey, Robert Horry, Jan 28, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Rudy Tomjanovich on Robert Horry
item.description:

“We thought could give the other teams problems and when we moved Robert Horry,”

Rudy Tomjanovich on Robert Horry, Apr 13, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Nick Young on Derek Fisher, Robert Horry
item.description:
Nick Young:

“Watching the Robert Horry shot, Kobe, Derek Fisher’s .4-second shot... Mine is kind of unique: I stole it from my own teammate.”

Nick Young on Derek Fisher, Robert Horry, Nov 23, 2016. Source: Twitter @KevinDing.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Robert Horry
item.description:
Baxter Holmes:Shaq on LAL days:

“Robert Horry was the whipping boy. Robert Horry used to always come in & say, ‘I ain’t gonna be your damn whipping boy.’”

Shaquille O'Neal on Robert Horry, Aug 31, 2015. Source: Twitter @BaxterHolmes.
